economic_hypothesis: A gap-down panic day that is fully absorbed by strong completed-session demand is more likely to represent a market-wide forced-inventory transfer when at least one other independent stock shows the same frozen event on that session. An isolated event is more likely to reflect stock-specific adverse information.
frozen_plain_language_rules: The stock lost at least 10 percent over the preceding 20 completed sessions.
The completed signal session opened at least 1 percent below the preceding close and made a new five-session low.
Signal-session turnover was at least the preceding 20-session mean.
The signal session closed at or above the preceding high and in the upper 30 percent of its own range.
At least one other independent stock produced the same frozen mother signal on that completed session.
